statement: Every exact checkout the push-gate materializer (scripts/checks/push-gate-corpus-worktree.js --gate) proves a command in - the pre-push gate, the publisher's local corpus and post-merge corpus, the local release proof - is brought to the generated state a CI or lab-placed proof checkout has before the command starts: the sealed import graph (test-output/analysis/global-owner-debt-import-graph.json) generated for that commit by its own producer, through one preparation owner that the lab placement shares. A clean checkout of b3b366573 then runs test/scripts/push-gate-change-proof.test.js green through the materializer, where it ran red (subtests 9, 10, 12, 13: import graph is not generated) in the post-merge corpus. A commit whose generated preparation fails or rewrites tracked metadata is refused, never run without it.

constraints.statement: Repair at the owner of the proof checkout (the materializer's exact-sha preparation), shared with the lab placement's generated-state list; no per-test regeneration, no skip, no fallback that runs a test without the material it reads.

Bounded repair of proof-checkout preparation. The tests that read the sealed graph are correct to read it (the gate's own import closure is what they assert); they are not rewritten. Unrelated corpus failures seen in the same post-merge run are recorded, not absorbed.

Red first in a clean materialized checkout at b3b366573 without the dev checkout's generated files, then green through the repaired materializer; a test of the preparation owner that fails when the preparation is removed; independent verification before landing.
